title: What ancient eggshells can tell us about extinction
description: CU Boulder Professor Emeritus Gifford Miller contributed to a study that sheds new light on the extinction of one of Australia's oversized flightless birds—and could help scientists answer bigger questions about extinction.

title: The secrets of the desert: Exploring Uzbekistan's ancient landscapes and living traditions
description: Ancient fortresses, sacred monuments and reclaimed steppe landscapes reveal how people adapted to life across Uzbekistan's deserts, where water has long determined settlement and survival.

title: In 2023, multiple deep-sea submersible trips found surprising samples, now a study traces ancient graveyard in Indian ocean
description: Whale Graveyard: Why did so many whales die here? Maybe they were already living in the area and died of natural causes. A few could have perished from exhaustion or illness caused by deep-sea diving.

title: The Black Alpine Pig is the only native ancient breed to have survived
description: The Black Alpine Pig has been saved: The Federal Office for Agriculture (BLW) has officially recognized the nearly extinct breed. This makes it the only surviving ancient pig breed in Switzerland.

title: Ancient beetle fossil sheds light on firefly glow and antenna evolution
description: A 100-million-year-old beetle preserved in amber is offering scientists a rare peek into the early evolution of fireflies' signature light shows and their remarkable antennae.
